rows.label: Kimi Antonelli
rows.hook: stepped into a Mercedes seat as a teenager to replace a seven-time world champion

rows.label: Lewis Hamilton
rows.hook: won seven Formula 1 world titles and holds the record for most race wins

rows.label: Michael Schumacher
rows.hook: won seven Formula 1 world titles, five of them in a row with Ferrari

rows.label: Charles Leclerc
rows.hook: is the Ferrari star who finally won his home Grand Prix after years of heartbreak

rows.label: Ayrton Senna
rows.hook: was a three-time world champion whose fatal crash at Imola shocked the sport

rows.label: Niki Lauda
rows.hook: returned to racing weeks after a fiery crash at the Nurburgring and won a third title

rows.label: George Russell
rows.hook: is a Mercedes driver nicknamed Mr. Saturday for his qualifying pace

rows.label: Fernando Alonso
rows.hook: won back-to-back Formula 1 titles with Renault and kept racing well into his forties

rows.label: Pierre Gasly
rows.hook: won the Italian Grand Prix in a shock result in a small AlphaTauri car

rows.label: Ken Miles
rows.hook: was the racer played by Christian Bale in the film Ford v Ferrari

rows.label: Kimi Räikkönen
rows.hook: is the last driver to win the Formula 1 title for Ferrari, nicknamed the Iceman

rows.label: Sebastian Vettel
rows.hook: won four straight world titles with Red Bull as a young star

rows.label: James Hunt
rows.hook: won a dramatic title fight against a rival that was dramatised in the film Rush

rows.label: Arvid Lindblad
rows.hook: is a young Red Bull junior who made his Formula 1 debut in his late teens

rows.label: Dale Earnhardt
rows.hook: was the seven-time NASCAR champion known as The Intimidator, killed on the last lap at Daytona

rows.label: Valentino Rossi
rows.hook: won nine motorcycle world titles and wears the number 46

rows.label: Oscar Piastri
rows.hook: is a McLaren driver who fought for the Formula 1 title after winning races in papaya orange

rows.label: Carlos Sainz Jr.
rows.hook: is nicknamed the Smooth Operator and drove for Ferrari, Williams and more

rows.label: Jenson Button
rows.hook: won the Formula 1 title with Brawn GP after the team's remarkable rebirth from Honda

rows.label: Daniel Ricciardo
rows.hook: is famous for his big grin and his celebratory shoey drinks from his boot

rows.label: Liam Lawson
rows.hook: was swapped mid-season between Red Bull and its sister team in a headline-making shuffle

rows.label: Mick Schumacher
rows.hook: is the son of a seven-time world champion and raced for Haas

rows.label: Jacques Villeneuve
rows.hook: won the Indianapolis 500 and a Formula 1 title, son of a famous racer

rows.label: Esteban Ocon
rows.hook: won a chaotic race in Hungary and drives for Alpine and Haas

rows.label: Yuki Tsunoda
rows.hook: is a Red Bull driver who became a fan favourite for radio outbursts and quick starts

rows.label: Valtteri Bottas
rows.hook: is a longtime Mercedes teammate famous for his shaved head and "To whom it may concern" radio line

rows.label: Alex Zanardi
rows.hook: lost both legs in a crash, then won gold medals at the Paralympic Games in handcycling

rows.label: Sergio Pérez
rows.hook: is nicknamed Checo and won several street races with Red Bull

rows.label: David Coulthard
rows.hook: won at Monaco twice and is now a familiar TV commentator

rows.label: Nigel Mansell
rows.hook: is known for a huge moustache and won the world title with Williams

rows.label: Gilles Villeneuve
rows.hook: was a fearless Ferrari driver whose daring cornering is still legendary

rows.label: Bruce McLaren
rows.description: New Zealand racecar driver, designer and team owner (1937-1970)
rows.hook: founded a team that still races today and won at Le Mans with Ford

rows.label: Oliver Bearman
rows.hook: filled in for Ferrari at a moment's notice as a teenager and impressed in Saudi Arabia

rows.label: Nico Hülkenberg
rows.hook: holds the record for most Grand Prix starts before a first podium and won at Le Mans

rows.label: Nelson Piquet
rows.hook: won three world titles and later had a driver son also race in the sport

rows.label: Alain Prost
rows.hook: is nicknamed The Professor and won four world titles for McLaren and Williams

rows.label: Juan Pablo Montoya
rows.description: Colombian racing driver; former Formula One driver
rows.hook: won the Indy 500 twice and once won at Monaco in a Williams

rows.label: Mika Häkkinen
rows.hook: won two titles for McLaren and is nicknamed the Flying Finn

rows.label: Jackie Stewart
rows.hook: won three world titles and campaigned tirelessly for motor racing safety

rows.label: Narain Karthikeyan
rows.hook: was the first driver from his nation to race in Formula 1

rows.label: Damon Hill
rows.hook: won the world title, following in the footsteps of his famous father

rows.label: Rubens Barrichello
rows.hook: holds a record for most Grand Prix starts and was Ferrari's loyal wingman

rows.label: Juan Manuel Fangio
rows.hook: won five world titles in the 1950s and is regarded as an all-time great

rows.label: Jim Clark
rows.hook: was a Lotus star who won two world titles and died in a Formula 2 race

rows.label: Graham Hill
rows.hook: is the only man to win the Monaco Grand Prix, Indy 500 and Le Mans, the Triple Crown

rows.label: Felipe Massa
rows.hook: lost the world title by a single point on the final corner of the last race

rows.label: Stirling Moss
rows.hook: is the greatest driver never to win a world title, nicknamed Mr. Motor Racing

rows.label: Gabriel Bortoleto
rows.hook: is a young Sauber driver who won the Formula 2 title as a rookie

rows.label: Martin Brundle
rows.hook: is a former racer turned TV commentator, known for his passionate grid walks

rows.label: Mark Webber
rows.hook: is the Red Bull driver who later won the World Endurance Championship with Porsche

rows.label: Jody Scheckter
rows.hook: won the world title with Ferrari and later became a farmer

rows.label: Keke Rosberg
rows.hook: won a world title in a Williams after taking only one race win that season

rows.label: Nicholas Latifi
rows.hook: is known for a controversial crash in Abu Dhabi that decided a championship

rows.label: Kevin Magnussen
rows.hook: is the son of a Le Mans class winner and a blunt-speaking Haas driver

rows.label: Robert Kubica
rows.hook: was a rising star who returned to racing after a near-fatal rally crash

rows.label: Jack Brabham
rows.hook: won three world titles including one in a car he built himself

rows.label: Jack Doohan
rows.hook: is the son of a motorcycle champion and briefly raced for Alpine

rows.label: Karun Chandhok
rows.hook: is a Formula 1 veteran turned motorsport commentator and Le Mans racer

rows.label: Eddie Irvine
rows.hook: nearly won the championship after his team leader broke a leg and he took over the title fight
